content:
👋 Hello everyone! # How did you find your way here? Well anyway, welcome to this little corner of the internet! I’m writing this at 2 AM after about four hours of sleep.
This site is a place to share my journey, thoughts, learning process, experiment, and occasional chaotic things with anyone who willing to read around my shenanigans.
Note: Everything here reflects my personal views and doesn’t represent any organization I’m connected to.
I’m open to suggestions and feedback. So, feel free to drop me a message on social media.
Thanks for stopping by and have a good trip ahead, fellow traveler.
title: Hello World!

👨‍💻 About Me # A purpose-driven cybersecurity enthusiast fueled by curiosity about how things work and how they break. I’m on a mission to deepen my skills in Red Team Area, aiming to not only understand the magic behind the systems but eventually build, break, and defend them.
📚 Education # Bachelor of Computer Science (Cybersecurity) Aug 2020 - Aug 2024 Universitas Bina Nusantara 💼 Experience # IT Security VAPT Specialist Jun 2024 - Present PT Adira Dinamika Multifinance Performed gray box and black box penetration testing across multiple platforms such as websites, API, mobile applications, desktop applications, and infrastructures. Create a local Active Directory environment with Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) and perform attack scenarios to assess detection readiness against malicious action. Conduct vulnerability assessment utilizing automated tools, evaluate findings, and report vulnerabilities utilizing a risk assessment template as an impact reference of risk. Coordinated with the Developer team to address the vulnerabilities found on applications by explaining the impact of findings based on risk and CVSS 4.0, and recommendations to fix vulnerabilities. Coordinated with the IT Operation team, Network team, and Data Center team to address the vulnerabilities found on servers by reporting vulnerability assessment results with an explanation of impact and risks. Create vulnerability management with a dashboard to track open and existing vulnerabilities using Microsoft Office applications. Collaborate with the core team and Developer team to implement Runtime Application Self-Protection and Hardware Security Module to several financial-related applications. Monitor to update information on new vulnerabilities, assessing the relevance and potential impact on the company’s assets. Assist in scoring Proof-of-Concept of vendors’ applications using a security-based checklist to ensure their capabilities from a security perspective. Collaborate with the SOC team to create a risk assessment report template with a risk matrix to define the impact of risk. Collaborate with the core team to create threat modeling for several applications. Assist management of penetration testing projects such as deciding mandays of penetration tests, creating timeline of vulnerability assessments, etc. Provide knowledge sharing on technical processes, documents, standards, and management-related to other team members. Cyber Security Intern Mar 2023 - Mar 2024 PT Deloitte Konsultan Indonesia Conduct Penetration Testing of websites, API, infrastructure, and mobile applications using OWASP Web Security Testing Guide, OWASP Top 10, and OWASP Mobile Security Testing Guide Frameworks. Assist several assessments such as Risk Assessment and Zero Trust Assessment based on ISO 27001 and 27002. Utilized Kali Linux operating system and several tools such as Burp Suite to conduct penetration testing. Create a report with CVSS 3.1 scoring and recommendation to remediate based on engagement using Microsoft Office application. Create vulnerability management to track vulnerability using Microsoft Office application. 📜 Certification # Practical Network Penetration Tester (PNPT) May 2025 by TCM Security Learned to perform Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT) gathering, initial network access, internal network enumeration, Active Directory exploitation, privilege escalation, and domain controller compromise. Gained experience in professional report writing and delivering live debrief presentations, simulating real-world client engagements. Web Application Penetration Tester eXtreme (eWPTX) Apr 2025 - Apr 2028 by INE Learned to perform web application reconnaissance, authentication attack, injection, filter evasion, WAF bypass, server-side attacks, OWASP Web Security Testing Guide, API penetration testing, and Scoring a vulnerability based on CVSS 3.1. Certified Red Team Expert (CRTE) Aug 2024 – Aug 2027 by Altered Security Learned to perform further attack tactics to an Active Directory corporate environment and evade protections such as Microsoft Defender and Firewall with bypass tactics such as script obfuscation, AMSI bypass, access control misconfiguration utilizing Bloodhound, PowerSploit, Mimikatz, Rubeus, Kekeo, etc. Certified Red Team Professional (CRTP) Jan 2024 – Jan 2030 by Altered Security Learned to perform attacks to an Active Directory corporate environment, utilizing Bloodhound, PowerSploit, Mimikatz, Rubeus, Kekeo, etc. Certified CyberOps Associate Oct 2023 – Oct 2026 by Cisco Learned basic networking, cyber security concepts, forensic, SOC, and network hardening using Security Onion virtual machine and basic labs. Certified Appsec Practitioner (CAP) Jun 2023 by The SecOps Group Learned basic security implementation on website, common vulnerability on API and web, usage of headers, and web hardening. Security+ Jan 2023 – Mar 2026 by CompTIA Learned basic cyber security concepts, threats, vulnerabilities, mitigations, security architectures, security operations, risk management, and compliance. 🚀 Projects # Firemation - Firewall Automation Jan 2024 University Project Collaborated with a group to design and develop a Unix-based web application that automatically creates rules based on defined CSV format in Python where Firemation supports Firewalls such as Cisco, Fortinet Fortigate, and Palo Alto Networks with Netbox IP Address Management implementation to support auto detection of IP addresses and Zone. Face Card - Attendance Recording Program Jan 2022 University Project Collaborated with a group to design and develop a Windows-based application in Python that implements face recognition to record attendance, utilizing machine learning related libraries.
